title: Change a class
summary: classList changes class names on an element.

learningObjectives: Use classList.remove after add and predict the result.
Explain the example for change a class

blocks.text: classList changes class names on an element. CSS can then control what that class looks like.
The HTML examples are complete small page parts. Use this site's HTML Run button. Put the script after the elements it uses so those elements already exist.
Read the code step by step

items: `classList` changes class names so CSS can handle the appearance. Class names passed to it do not begin with a dot.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: The paragraph gets the bright class, so its background becomes gold.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Pass bright without a dot to classList.add. The dot is only part of a CSS selector.
